prompt:
Create one standalone 9:16 WORLD_KEYFRAME establishing an inside-book deep-ocean subject world, with absolute host isolation. Use a monochrome editorial zoological illustration: smooth matte bone-white paper with extremely light natural tooth; clean, confident soft-carbon-black monoline contours with rounded joins; simplified but biologically grounded anatomy; sparse graphite-gray hatching only where depth is essential; extremely restrained abyssal cyan used only for transparent anatomy or bioluminescence. Flat diffuse illustrative lighting, no modeled light source; communicate depth through overlap, scale, contour density, drifting particulate, bubbles, currents, and occasional restrained cyan glow.

Compose an organically interlocking deep-sea scene featuring several immediately recognizable strange ocean adaptations: a barreleye with transparent head dome and upward tubular eyes, goblin shark with protrusible jaws, vampire squid with webbed arms and tiny spines, leafy seadragon among seaweed, armored giant isopod, Dumbo octopus with ear-like fins, anglerfish with a small glowing lure, and blanket octopus with flowing web membrane. Keep silhouettes distinct with generous white breathing channels and an educational, curious, slightly uncanny but never horrific mood.

Repeat the world’s thin hand-drawn outer contour near the frame edge, occasionally interrupted by tiny marine marks. Use the full illustration height naturally; no caption reserve, blank strip, empty panel, or low-detail subtitle band. No recurring host, selected host, people, foreground character, readable text, labels, letters, numbers, UI, grid, sheet layout, swatches, photorealism, 3D CGI, anime, watercolor, collage, heavy gradients, dense engraving, or fantasy-monster anatomy. Reference input defines medium/style only, never composition. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a consistent clean off-white matte field bounded by a thin hand-drawn black contour near the outer edge, occasionally interrupted by tiny bubble, current, or plankton marks; each scene sits inside an organically interlocking line-art illustration window rather than a rigid panel, with generous white breathing channels separating creature silhouettes. The same thin contour weight, rounded corners, scattered miniature ocean marks, and open negative-space rhythm repeat across every body image. The lower edge transitions naturally into a quieter low-detail field rather than a hard caption box.. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI. Binding isolation: no recurring host, no selected host, and no foreground person or character.

The attached operator_style_reference is style-only. Preserve the newly established world plan while echoing only its texture, palette, line work and lighting; do not copy its subject, text, people, logo, or composition.
